scope: Same seed, examples and model architecture. Only the precomputed per-action warrant input is ablated. Warrant remains an environment-side evaluation and reward. The larger linked tasks are fictional controlled variants.

same_fixture_holdout.scope: Strictly typed private cards. A sender can pass or send an owned fact; the relay may forward only what it received in round 1. The chair sees only its delivered record and public domains. Model parameters are a trainable small CPU policy.
